changes.summary: Fixed mutateService so it only sends Content-Type: application/json when a request body exists. DELETE (no body) previously sent that header and Fastify rejected it with 400 FST_ERR_CTP_EMPTY_JSON_BODY, so the management-page delete button never took effect.

Extended the CallTool Unknown-tool branch: besides configured-but-disabled servers, a tool whose server prefix is no longer configured (deleted/removed) now returns an explicit isError result whose message contains 'disabled', instead of a bare 'Unknown tool'. Tools whose prefix matches a configured-but-enabled server still return the original JSON-RPC error.
Updated the toolRequestHandlers hunk to match the extended branch; validated with git apply --check against pristine @1mcp/agent 0.38.2.
